sentences.text: Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT

**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme "Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, provides financial assistance to Nomadic and De-notified Tribe students for pursuing higher education in self-financed colleges.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Universities and higher education

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT&quot; by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to support students belonging to Nomadic Tribes and De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT) categories in accessing quality education in self-financed colleges by reducing the financial burden. Through this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹50,000/- is provided to cover tuition fees, registration charges, education fees, and other scholarship-related expenses for students enrolled in self-financed colleges. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, and seeks to empower NT/DNT students with improved access to higher education opportunities.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹50,000/- for tuition fee, registration fee, education fee, and other scholarship-related charges.

**Application Process:** > **How to Register:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Digital Gujarat](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) portal. **Step 2:** The user should click on the &quot;Click to register&quot; option. Fill all details and click on &quot;Save&quot;. <br> > **How to Log In:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Digital Gujarat](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) portal. **Step 2:** The user should click on the &quot;Login&quot; option. **Step 3:** Enter all details and click on &quot;Login&quot;. <br> > **How to Apply for a New Service:** **Step 1:** After logging in, select the relevant department. **Step 2**: Choose the specific service to apply for within that department. **Step 3:** Fill out all required details in the application form. **Step 4:** Upload, attach, or browse necessary documents. Alternatively, import documents directly from DigiLocker. **Step 5:** Carefully review all entered information. **Step 6:** Submit the application. **Step 7:** Once the application is completed, proceed to payment to download the certificate. **Step 8:** Upon successful payment, the certificate will be available for download. <br> &gt; **Digital Gujarat (Help Desk):** Contact No : 18002335500
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
**Tags:** Higher Education, Scholarship, Nomadic And Denotified Tribe
